raw_segments.text: Here was an answer that set Ingmar thinking. He wondered whether he had better speak or be silent.
If he were to speak, it might end in a break with his family. At the same time,
he did not want them to think that he upheld them in matters that were altogether wrong.
I have never seen any signs of ungodliness about the schoolmaster's folks, he retorted,
and yet I have lived with them for four years.
